name: Octopus
description: Sidebar dashboard for round-based multi-agent runs: members, a live data-flow map, task board, plan approvals, team board and file claims. Ships with a demo run and a documented data contract so you can plug in your own team runtime.

cover.alt: Octopus run dashboard in Orca: member cards, a data-flow map connecting actors to shared parts, and a feed of the latest flows.

screenshots.alt: The Octopus panel showing members, data flow, task board, plan approvals and latest flows for a sample run.
screenshots.caption: A team run at a glance, inside the Orca sidebar.
